subject.title: Architecture: reduce import coupling in pi-embedded-runner/attempt.ts (50+ imports) and discord monitor (30 imports)

question: Should this issue be narrowed to the remaining Discord monitor boundary while https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/72072 exclusively owns embedded-runner restructuring?
rationale: Both areas remain coupled, but the runner now has a detailed canonical RFC and implementation sequence; maintainers must choose whether to preserve a cross-owner umbrella or remove the overlap before implementation proceeds.

options.title: Narrow to Discord
options.body: Keep this issue for Discord preflight/process responsibility splits and route all embedded-runner work through the RuntimePlan RFC.

options.title: Keep the umbrella
options.body: Retain both surfaces here and explicitly coordinate every runner stage with the RuntimePlan RFC to avoid duplicate work.

options.title: Replace with narrower tracking
options.body: Close this umbrella only after creating or confirming a dedicated Discord architecture issue and preserving the relevant evidence there.

recommendation.title: Narrow to Discord
recommendation.body: Keep this issue for Discord preflight/process responsibility splits and route all embedded-runner work through the RuntimePlan RFC.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the prior keep-open review and has recent history on both affected ownership surfaces.
